content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 C4Media Inc.: Demand Generation Specialist Anywhere in the World Ontario Copywriting, Digital Marketing, Marketing Automation, Marketing Management, Product Marketing, Content Writing, English, and Email Campaigns Sales and Marketing Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6430/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Toronto, Ontario <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://c4media.com/">https://c4media.com/</a> </p> <p>C4Media, Inc. is looking for a <strong>Demand Generation Specialist (Contractor)</strong> to join our fully remote, global team.</p> <p>You’ll own digital marketing campaigns that drive QCon registrations, certification enrollments, and InfoQ Live registrations. This is a hands-on, results-driven role where you’ll write copy, manage email campaigns and audience segments, run paid advertising, analyze performance, and continuously improve our marketing processes.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is an experienced digital marketer who enjoys building repeatable campaigns, reaching new audiences, and writing compelling content for a technical audience of senior software engineers and architects. Experience with marketing conferences, certifications, courses, or professional development is a strong plus.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul class="_1a5401c6 _853c7f99 d1901be7"> <li>Own end-to-end demand generation campaigns for QCon, certifications, and InfoQ Live.</li> <li>Create email sequences, landing page copy, social posts, and paid ad copy.</li> <li>Manage audience segmentation, exclusions, automations, and email campaigns.</li> <li>Plan and execute organic and paid campaigns across Google, LinkedIn, and social channels.</li> <li>Track and report weekly on registrations, enrollments, cost per registration, and revenue.</li> <li>Maintain marketing dashboards, trackers, and campaign calendars.</li> <li>Test new channels and strategies to reach audiences beyond our existing database.</li> <li>Build repeatable campaign processes and continuously improve performance.</li> <li>Coordinate campaigns across products while managing shared audiences and contact limits.</li> <li>Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate research, content creation, testing, analysis, and automation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></p> <ul class="_1a5401c6 _853c7f99 d1901be7"> <li>5+ years of experience in digital marketing and demand generation, with a strong focus on email and lifecycle marketing.</li> <li>Proven experience driving measurable registrations, enrollments, leads, or sales.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Marketo, Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar.</li> <li>Excellent written and spoken English, with strong copywriting skills for technical audiences.</li> <li>Experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GA4, and organic social media.</li> <li>Strong analytical and reporting skills.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.</li> <li>A proactive approach to staying current with marketing platforms, tools, trends, and best practices.</li> <li>Comfortable using AI tools to improve marketing performance and productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Remote Work Requirements</strong></p> <ul class="_1a5401c6 _853c7f99 d1901be7"> <li>Must reside in Europe</li> <li>Able to work in a full-time remote position</li> <li>Able to work in overlap with our core global office hours (9 AM - 1 PM EST)</li> <li>Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable home-office setup</li> <li>Willing and able to travel to the USA or Europe 1–3 times per year for conferences and company meetings</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why work at C4Media</strong></p> <ul class="_1a5401c6 _853c7f99 d1901be7"> <li><strong>Work from home - always</strong>: We are a remote-first and remote-always team that has been successfully operating on a work-from-home basis since 2007. And we have no intention of changing that.</li> <li><strong>Travel the world:</strong> C4Media offers an opportunity to travel 3-4 times a year at our expense to NYC, SF, London, and other fun, global locations for conferences &amp; team building. We also got you covered to add a sightseeing day to the end of the trip.</li> <li><strong>Take care of each other:</strong> We look out for one another and prioritize respect, fairness, support, and well-being. Check out our core values on our careers page.</li> <li><strong>Learn something new:</strong> C4Media’s culture is one of learning &amp; mastering. Everyone has a training and education budget for professional growth every year and is encouraged to use it.</li> <li><strong>Make friends across the world</strong>: Be a part of a leading, fast-growing international company and build a network of international friends and colleagues for life.</li> <li><strong>Support wellbeing:</strong> In an effort to make physical activity more readily accessible, we offer staff an annual subsidy towards fitness and wellness.</li> <li><strong>Generous paid time off:</strong> In addition to 25 paid days off in the 1st year and 30 paid days off in every subsequent year, we provide 1 paid day off for birthdays (or a similar special day) and 2 paid days for continuing education.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Qualified candidates are to submit their applications on our C4Media website.
